Access.name: verificaProvincia
Access.Query: select cast(decode(PROV_D_FINE_VAL,to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy'),null,PROV_D_FINE_VAL) as date) from CLL.V_PROV where PROV_X_PROV = ?

Access.name: verificaComune
Access.Query:
SELECT DISTINCT COMU.COMU_X_DENOM_COMU , CAP.CAP_C_CAP , PROV.PROV_C_PROV , to_char(COMU.COMU_C_COMU) , cast(decode(PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL,to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy'),null,PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL) as date) , cast(decode(COMU.COMU_D_FINE_VAL,to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy'),null,COMU.COMU_D_FINE_VAL) as date) FROM CLL.V_COMU COMU , CLL.CAP CAP , ( SELECT CAP_C_PROV as PROV_C_PROV, CAP_X_LOC, MIN(CAP_C_CAP) as MIN_CAP, MAX(CAP_C_CAP) as MAX_CAP, MAX(DAT_FINE_VALID) as PROV_D_FINE_VAL, MIN(CAP_N_PROGR) as CAP_N_PROGR FROM CLL.CAP GROUP BY CAP_C_PROV, CAP_X_LOC ) PROV WHERE CAP.CAP_C_CAP BETWEEN COMU.CAP_C_AVVIAM_POSTL_MIN AND COMU.CAP_C_AVVIAM_POSTL_MAX AND COMU.PROV_C_PROV = PROV.PROV_C_PROV AND trim(COMU.COMU_X_DENOM_COMU) =
comune AND trim(PROV.PROV_C_PROV) =
provincia AND PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') AND trim(CAP.CAP_C_CAP) =
cap AND COMU.COMU_D_FINE_VAL = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy')

Access.name: verificaComuneIscrittoAlCatasto
Access.Query:
select distinct CATASTO.DEN_COMU , null , PROV.PROV_C_PROV , to_char(CATASTO.COD_CATAS_COMU) , cast(decode(PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL,to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy'),null,PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL) as date) from CLL.V_PROV PROV , CLL.ANAG_CATAST_COMUN CATASTO where CATASTO.COD_PROV = PROV.PROV_C_PROV and (CATASTO.COD_PROV != 'EE' OR (CATASTO.COD_PROV = 'EE' AND substr(CATASTO.COD_FISC_COMU,1) != 'Z')) and trim(CATASTO.DEN_COMU) =
comune and trim(PROV.PROV_C_PROV) =
provincia and (PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') or PROV.PROV_C_PROV = 'EE')

Access.name: verificaSeAnagraficaUtilizzataInMHD
Access.Query: select count(C_POTENZIALE) from MHD_SOGGETTI_SOLUZ where C_POTENZIALE = ?

Access.name: verificaPresentatoreIntestCointestContoDepositoAttivoINR
Access.Query: SELECT case when (count(*) > 1) then 'S' else 'N' end FROM CLL.CONTR CP , CLL.CONTRCLI LCC WHERE CP.PROD_C = LCC.PROD_C AND CP.CONTR_N = LCC.CONTR_N AND LCC.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR IN ('I','P','C') AND CP.PROD_C = 'BAN01' AND CP.CONTR_C_CAT = '0076' AND CP.CONTR_C_SCAT = '001' AND CP.CONTR_C_CONV IN ('000761' , '000762', '000763', '000764', '000765', '000766') AND CP.CONTR_D_ESTI = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') AND LCC.CLI_C = ?

Access.name: verificaPresentatoreIntestCointestContoDepositoCEPE
Access.Query: SELECT count(*) FROM CEPE_CONTRATTI_ELETTRONICI a, INR_DISPCLI b WHERE a.TIPDISP_C_TIPDISP = '115' AND b.DISP_C_DISP = a.DISP_C_DISP and b.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL = ?

Access.name: selezionaDataInvioContoDepositoPotenziale
Access.Query: SELECT max(a.DISP_D_CAMBIO_STATO) FROM CEPE_CONTRATTI_ELETTRONICI a, INR_DISPCLI b WHERE a.TIPDISP_C_TIPDISP = '115' AND a.TIPDISPSTATO_C_TIPDISPSTATO = '03' AND b.DISP_C_DISP = a.DISP_C_DISP AND b.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = ?

Access.name: isEmailDiAltroCliente
Access.Query: select decode(count(*),0,'N','S') from CLL.IND I inner join CLL.CLI C on I.CLI_C = C.CLI_C where I.IND_C_TIP = 'IB' and I.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and C.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and C.CLI_C_SESSO in ('M','F') and C.CLI_X_CF != ? and upper(trim(I.IND_X_IND)) = upper(?)

Access.name: isCellulareDiAltroCliente
Access.Query: SELECT decode(count(*),0,'N','S') FROM CLL.CLI C INNER JOIN CLL.TEL T ON C.CLI_C = T.CLI_C WHERE C.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND T.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' AND C.CLI_C_SESSO in ('M','F') AND trim(nvl(T.TEL_C,'0')) = '2' and substr(T.TEL_C_PREF,1) !='0' AND C.CLI_X_CF != CAST( ? as CHAR(16)) AND T.TEL_C_PREF = CAST(? AS CHAR(8)) AND T.TEL_X_NUM = CAST(? AS CHAR(12))

Access.name: verificaSeFalsoProspect
Access.Query: select A.CLI_C as CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL from CLL.CLI A where A.CLI_X_CF = ? AND (A.CLI_C_SESSO in ('M','F') and (A.CLI_C_NCG in ('FMM','FFF' ) or rtrim(ltrim(A.CLI_C_NCG)) is null)) AND (A.CLI_C_COD_BLOCCO != 'R' OR A.CLI_C_COD_BLOCCO IS NULL)

Access.name: verificaSeFalsoProspectDitta
Access.Query: select A.CLI_C as CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL from CLL.CLI A where A.CLI_N_PIVA = ? AND (A.CLI_C_COD_BLOCCO != 'R' OR A.CLI_C_COD_BLOCCO IS NULL)
